# Thamco360
> Bengaluru-based 360° photography and photogrammetry studio. We turn on-site captures into scroll-driven, navigable 3D virtual tours for real estate, hospitality, weddings & events, and museums & galleries. We travel to the client's property — no showroom.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://www.thamco360.com/): Hero 360° tour, live portfolio, spatial capture pipeline, FAQ, and enquiry form.
- [Services](https://www.thamco360.com/services.html): Per-industry breakdown — Real Estate, Hospitality, Weddings & Events, Museums & Galleries.
- [About](https://www.thamco360.com/about.html): Vision, values, and who we are.

## Key facts
- Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; service-area business, no fixed storefront.
- Contact: +91 70901 11360 (WhatsApp/phone), thamco360@gmail.com.
- Scan crews deploy within 48 hours of booking.
- Services: 360° Virtual Tour, Website Development, Web 3D Development (Immersive).
